$comment: Checkbox and radio, the mark a CheckButton draws: ui/lib/nidara-kit/styles/_components.scss check/radio — 18px, a 1.5px border on the surface, turning accent when checked; the checkbox at radius xs, the radio round. Checked, the checkbox carries a tick in the accent's foreground and the radio a 4px band of the window background inside its border, leaving an accent dot. Hover lifts the fill and the border, a press darkens the fill.
Default applies to every component mode variant.
